doc: Menu sounds by listening (M2-AUD-05; ADR 0031; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). UiAudio (game/audio/ui_audio.gd) watches every node whose script's global class (or a base class) has a hook here, and never writes it. signals: signal -> sfx row (the signal's arguments are dropped). on_enter / on_exit: a row when the menu is attached (deferred, after its _ready) or leaves the tree. watch: Expressions over `node` read once a frame (the first read is the baseline; a failed read changes nothing): a change plays sfx; rise / fall when a number goes up / down; values maps the new value (as text) to a row; on_true plays only when the new value is truthy. page_with_row(page, row_id) is in scope: the page's instance id when it shows that row, else 0. priority: one frame plays at most one UI row, the first of this list among those asked for (unlisted rows come last). pending: the class has not landed on this branch yet; the checker skips its class and signal names until it does, and the hook does nothing until then. tools/audio/data_check.py checks every row, class and signal.
